I want the best bang for the buck, not the cheapest or the most expensive.

That makes total sense, especially with plants that are a long-term investment.

To really zero in on “best bang for the buck,” I want to match you with something that:

Performs really well (lots of blooms, good vigor)
Fits your space and climate
Doesn’t demand constant extra care

A couple of quick questions so I can be specific instead of guessing:

Which roses or collections are you currently looking at? (Names or copy-pasting product links is perfect.)
What are your top priorities besides value? For example, pick 2–3 that matter most:
Strong fragrance
Specific color(s)
Tons of blooms for most of the season
Great for cutting/bouquets
Very low maintenance / high disease resistance
Compact for containers / small spaces vs large and showy in the landscape
What hardiness zone are you in, if you know it? (Or your city/region, and I can help you think about conditions.)

Once I have that, I can compare your exact options and tell you which one gives you the most overall value for what you care about, not just the lowest price.
